text:
Filip Hronek's name has entered the Vancouver trade conversation. Daily Faceoff's David Pagnotta says the Canucks are "open for business" and that "I believe that we will hear more of Filip Hronek's name," while The Hockey Writers argued the team should revisit talks with Boston.

In the meantime he's playing more than anyone. Rink Wide's Jeff Paterson noted no one in the NHL is playing more than Hronek this month: 27:58 a night over his last ten games, 26:35 for the season. He has 14 points in 23 games, eight on the power play, plus 44 blocked shots.

The even-strength picture is rough. Vancouver gets 37% of the 5v5 expected goals (chance quality) with him on the ice, five points worse than without him. Context matters, though: Evolving-Hockey had him playing with teammates in the bottom 6% by impact last season and still ranked him 41st of 215 defensemen by wins above replacement, mostly from power-play work. A contender would be buying the minutes and the power play, and betting the 5v5 numbers are about Vancouver as much as him.
headline: Hronek, the minutes sponge, on the market
